tool_args.rationale: The data show both sink-gradient sensitivity and a long-horizon reversal. Fit an additive siphon base with dual-timescale adaptation, allowing several concrete locations for sink coupling, and test the resulting numerically fitted model on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous fit was refuted on fresh confirmation and did not adequately fit the training observations.
A static response cannot explain the horizon reversal, while the pilot shows substantial sink-gradient dependence.
The existing 11 observations span short, intermediate, and target-scale horizons; test a revised coupled mechanism before buying further measurements.
